description: Use this when you are working in an app's code and can run commands (a coding agent) and the user wants App Store or Google Play screenshots of that app. Returns the full appdesigns recipe for one platform and store, as markdown: how to pick the screens, how to check and populate demo data with the user's consent, the exact capture commands (simulator or emulator, status bar, deep links), the caption rules, and the upload and hand-off steps. Not for a chat without a terminal, where the screenshots come as attachments instead. Read-only; changes nothing.

platform.description: How the app is built: ios (Swift or Objective-C), android (Kotlin or Java), expo, react-native, flutter, or web (a web app or PWA).

store.description: Which store the screenshots are for.

name: get_workflow
title: Get the screenshot workflow
